headline: Pampa Energía Forms AI Company and Accelerates Data Center Investments
summary: Pampa Energía and its partners have registered a new artificial intelligence company to monetize Vaca Muerta natural gas and accelerate investments in data centers.
why: Energy companies diversifying into digital infrastructure and artificial intelligence aim to monetize excess natural gas reserves through high-power-demand data centers.

impacts.name: Pampa Energía
impacts.why: Venture expansion into artificial intelligence and data centers diversifies business operations and capital deployment.
